verdict.rationale: Bolt documents native Stripe integration for payments/subscriptions [bolt-docs-9], Supabase for hosted DB, auth, and edge functions [bolt-docs-22], and general ability to run Node.js servers and call third-party APIs from the builder [bolt-gh-3][bolt-gh-2]. However, there's no explicit mention of email-sending integrations, and one community report describes a real payment-flow breakage tied to a botched deployment rather than the integration itself [bolt-comm-8], adding a caveat to reliability. missing for 10: dedicated email/transactional-messaging integration, independent verification that Stripe/Supabase setups work end-to-end without manual fixes.
